snippet.title: Ocean Keeper Co-op - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮 Play the game now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3937360/Ocean_Keeper_Coop?utm_source=YT&utm_campaign=rsg

Fight against endless waves of sea monsters, protect your Mech and mine valuable resources in Ocean Keeper Co-op – a survival co-op roguelike with tower defense elements. Play the free demo on Steam, team up with friends, or dive solo as one of four miners in this action-packed multiplayer survival experience.

Discover the beauty and danger of the ocean depths, filled with strange creatures, hidden treasures and lurking threats. Upgrade your gear, strengthen your base and push through each wave to survive. Whether you're a fan of dome keeper, wall world or indie co-op games, Ocean Keeper delivers a unique underwater challenge.

👉 Join our Discord to share feedback and join Community+Devs regular playtests: https://discord.gg/5ZWUTEpCNf
❤️ Wishlist Ocean Keeper Co-op to support the devs and never miss an update.
